frr.name: FRRouting
frr.os: Debian Bookworm FRR · record installed version
frr.scope: Integrated BGP configuration for the isolated native lab

iosxe.name: Cisco IOS XE
iosxe.scope: IPv4 BGP, prefix lists and inbound local preference

iosxr.name: Cisco IOS XR
iosxr.scope: IPv4 BGP prefix sets and route policies

junos.name: Juniper Junos
junos.scope: IPv4 external BGP and exact route-filter policies

routeros.name: MikroTik RouterOS
routeros.scope: Filter chains only; bind to the installed version's BGP connections

vrp.name: Huawei VRP
vrp.scope: IPv4 BGP, exact IP prefixes and inbound local preference

sros.name: Nokia SR OS
sros.os: SR OS Classic CLI · policy fragment
sros.scope: Base-router BGP and transactional policy options

boundary: Native lab definitions and version-scoped routing fragments. No daemons or vendor OS run in the browser. Public test subscriber only; no operator credentials. Apply only after interface mapping and native validation in the matching isolated lab.

    "service_vlan": 201,

frr defaults traditional
hostname JKT-001
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
ip prefix-list LOCAL seq 10 permit 10.81.1.0/24
ip prefix-list LOCAL seq 20 permit 10.80.1.1/32
ip prefix-list CORE seq 10 permit 10.90.0.0/24
route-map PRIMARY permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list CORE
 set local-preference 100
route-map SECONDARY permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list CORE
 set local-preference 80
route-map EXPORT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list LOCAL
router bgp 65101
 bgp router-id 10.80.1.1
 neighbor 10.250.0.1 remote-as 65100
 neighbor 10.251.0.1 remote-as 65200
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.81.1.0/24
  network 10.80.1.1/32
  neighbor 10.250.0.1 route-map PRIMARY in
  neighbor 10.251.0.1 route-map SECONDARY in
  neighbor 10.250.0.1 route-map EXPORT out
  neighbor 10.251.0.1 route-map EXPORT out
 exit-address-family
!
line vty

# Native Open5GS v2.7.6 isolated lab; not a measured or live-validated deployment.
# Public DNS addresses are upstream defaults; the internal Docker network has no Internet egress.
logger:
  file:
    path: /lab/logs/amf.log
  level: info
global:
  max:
    ue: 1024
amf:
  sbi:
    server:
    - address: 127.0.0.5
      port: 7777
    client:
      scp:
      - uri: http://127.0.0.200:7777
  ngap:
    server:
    - address: 172.28.80.50
  metrics:
    server:
    - address: 172.28.80.50
      port: 9090
  guami:
  - plmn_id: &id001
      mcc: '001'
      mnc: '01'
    amf_id:
      region: 2
      set: 1
  tai:
  - plmn_id: *id001
    tac: 1
  plmn_support:
  - plmn_id: *id001
    s_nssai:
    - sst: 1
      sd: '000001'
  security:
    integrity_order:
    - NIA2
    - NIA1
    - NIA0
    ciphering_order:
    - NEA0
    - NEA1
    - NEA2
  network_name:
    full: Strata Isolated Lab
    short: Strata
  amf_name: strata-amf0
  time:
    t3512:
      value: 540

logger:

global:

    client:
      scp:
      - uri: http://127.0.0.200:7777
  pfcp:
    server:
    - address: 127.0.0.4
    client:
      upf:
      - address: 127.0.0.7
  gtpc:
    server:
    - address: 127.0.0.4
  gtpu:
    server:
    - address: 127.0.0.4
  metrics:
    server:
    - address: 172.28.80.50
      port: 9091
  session:
  - subnet: 10.45.0.0/16
    gateway: 10.45.0.1
    dnn: internet
  dns:
  - 8.8.8.8
  - 8.8.4.4
  mtu: 1400
  freeDiameter: /opt/open5gs/etc/freeDiameter/smf.conf

# Native Open5GS v2.7.6 isolated lab; not a measured or live-validated deployment.
